summary: All 6 first-pass findings verified by independent reproduction: 6 confirmed (one defect_type recalibrated D2->D12 for the simps import crash, which is also an already-known fact), 0 refuted, 0 uncertain; severities all stand. One missed minor D8 added (allclose broadcasting accepts 1-D radial profiles). The problem is doubly broken — guaranteed 0/4 at import under scipy>=1.14, and even past that the frozen (61,51) polar absolute-intensity targets encode an algorithm that contradicts the Cartesian docstring and is unrecoverable even by target-informed fitting (peak ratio 3.9155 excludes every prompt-supported model class). Fixable to fair only with heavy effort: the one-line simps alias is trivial, but making the problem scoreable requires a full prompt rewrite plus regenerated targets from a newly authored, fully-specified reference implementation (original gold is unavailable).
